import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem sprint_development_0109 {A B C : Set α} : A ⊆ B → B ⊆ C → A ⊆ C := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem sprint_development_0109 {A B C : Set α} : A ⊆ B → B ⊆ C → A ⊆ C := by
  intros hAB hBC x hxAB
  have hxBC : x ∈ C := hBC hxAB
  exact hxBC
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0109 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0109 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0109

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.sprint_development_0109
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.sprint_development_0109
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
